messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error spike started ~2330456760. Threshold: 3% -> observed 12%. Paging oncall.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs and looking at metrics now. any customer reports?

jake (eng-runtime): saw similar earlier in staging when model runner hit kernel OOM on long seqs. can you paste last logs?

maria (sre): bringing up traces. tracer shows repeated SIGSEGV in model-runner process on node gpu-3b. stack shows nvml + custom allocator.

raj (prod-support): luke, CS — one mid-size customer reported timeouts in their chat service. their requests started failing ~2330456800.

luke (customer-success): yep, they opened a ticket. errors are 502/503 at gateway. they're seeing partial responses then closures. asking for ETA.

sara (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation idea: shift traffic for the hottest model variant to the fallback quantized variant and mark current pool draining. will run a weighted routing override. thoughts?

jake (eng-runtime): +1. also enable kernel-fallback path (less-perf but more stable) for that model on the fleet. I can toggle it if SRE gives green.

maria (sre): rolling a routing override now to route 85% -> fallback-quant, 15% -> original for canary. applying to us-west-2.

deploy-bot: routing-override applied by maria at 2330456902. config id: r-ff8b2a.

sara (oncall): restarting model-runner pods on gpu-3b to clear corrupted state. command:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-runner -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-3b
```

jake (eng-runtime): logs from one pod before restart:
```
[2026-11-02T12:08:21Z] model-runner[pid=1523]: allocation failed: out-of-memory trying to reserve 2.1GB for KV cache
[2026-11-02T12:08:21Z] model-runner[pid=1523]: fatal: uncaught segfault at 0x7fffc000
backtrace:
  0x7f1a2b3c nvml_allocator.cpp:412
  0x7f1a2b8d model_execution.cpp:1291
  0x7f1a3c00 run_request.cpp:87
```

maria (sre): that matches the OOM hypothesis. I'm scaling the dedicated pool up by +2 replicas temporarily and enabling eviction threshold bump to avoid immediate OOM churn.

raj (prod-support): communicating to customer: telling them we rotated traffic to fallback model and expect reduced errors in ~2-4 minutes. will update them when stable.

luke (customer-success): they acknowledge, appreciate the quick response. asking for incident link and postmortem ETA.

sara (oncall): latest metrics: 5xx rate dropped to 4.2% after routing override and restarts. continuing to observe. latency up ~30ms on fallback but acceptable.

jake (eng-runtime): started running a memory dump on the crashed pod to analyze allocator behavior. uploading to /mnt/artifacts/2330456789/dumps.

maria (sre): auto-retry middleware at edge increased retries from 1->2 to mask transient 5xx while we stabilize. note: this will add small increase in 429 risk for bursty clients.

sara (oncall): we should put a temporary circuit-breaker for the heavy customer if errors persist, to protect other tenants. raj, coordinate with CS for opt-in.

raj (prod-support): on it. told them we can throttle their route for the next 30m if needed.

jake (eng-runtime): debug dump shows rapid KV cache growth on long context requests; an allocation path didn't respect the per-request cap. pushing a hotfix to cap per-request KV cache allocation. patch id: gh#fix/kv-cap-2330.

sara (oncall): can we hotpatch or do a rolling deploy?

jake (eng-runtime): I'll build a canary image and deploy to 2 nodes in us-west-2 with kernel-fallback enabled. doing a canary rollout now.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started by jake at 2330457120. image: registry.redwood/inference/model-runner:canary-kvcap-2330.

sara (oncall): monitoring canary. if green for 5m we'll escalate rollout. current 5xx: 2.1%.

luke (customer-success): customer updated, they're seeing improvement. still some intermittent 503s but much better.

maria (sre): canary looks stable at +6m. CPU/GPU stable, no segfaults in canary pods. recommend progressive rollout.

jake (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix to remaining nodes in us-west-2. will keep kernel-fallback on for 30m post-rollout then reassess.

sara (oncall): okay, after rollout we'll revert routing override back to normal and scale down the extra replicas we added.

maria (sre): FYI root cause likely a combination of per-request KV cache growth + rare allocator race on certain GPU driver versions. recording for postmortem.

raj (prod-support): customer confirmed: ticket downgraded to P2, grateful for quick mitigation.

luke (customer-success): logged the customer communication and follow-up items.

sara (oncall): handing off to night oncall @michael at 2330457329. summary: transient OOMs/segfaults caused elevated 5xx, mitigations applied: routing override to fallback quantized model, pod restarts, temporary scale up, transient retries at edge, canary hotfix deployed and rolled out. monitor for recurrence.

incident-bot: escalation routed to michael for night shift at 2330457329.

maria (sre): adding postmortem todo: verify driver matrix, add per-request KV cap tests, add telemetry for per-request memory growth, ensure allocator handles race.

sara (oncall): thanks all. I'll draft the incident summary and timeline first thing. good job team :thumbsup:
